info.name: Kargo Public GraphQL API
info.description:
Collection for the Kargo Public GraphQL API at https://api.kargo.zone/public_graphql.

Authentication: Auth0 JWT — set the `access_token` collection variable with your Bearer token.

All requests inherit the Bearer token auth defined at the collection level.

variable.description: Base URL for the public GraphQL endpoint
Auth0 JWT access token — populated automatically by the 'Get Access Token' request

request.description:
Obtains an Auth0 access token using client credentials.

1. Set the `client_id` and `client_secret` collection variables with the credentials provided by Kargo.
2. Send this request — the `access_token` collection variable is automatically populated via the test script.
3. All subsequent GraphQL requests will use that token via the collection-level Bearer auth.

Fetches the full GraphQL schema via introspection. Returns all types, fields, arguments, enums, and directives available in the API. Useful for exploring the schema or importing it into a GraphQL client.
Health check — returns true if the API is reachable.
Retrieves a global list of Business objects stored by Kargo. Individual Business details are restricted by permission scope.
Retrieves a single Shipment object by Kargo-ID. Replace the `id` variable with the target shipment's integer ID.
Retrieves all push messages since a given timestamp for a business or facility. `facilitySlug` is optional — omit to get messages for all facilities.
Downloads the current Kargo agent implementation. Returns a single-use download token valid for 5 minutes. Use the token at: api.kargo.zone/download_agent_with_token?token=<token>
Lists shipments for all accessible facilities with an optional date filter. `shippingDirection` can be SHIPPING, RECEIVING, MIXED, or UNKNOWN.
Lists Order objects for a facility within a date range. `direction` can be INBOUND or OUTBOUND.
Lists all SKUs associated with each accessible facility.
Creates a new shipment along with its associated order and order items in a single request.
Updates shipment status from an external scheduling system. `status` can be SCHEDULED, AT_FACILITY, DOOR_ASSIGNED, or CHECKED_OUT.
Creates a new order. `quantityUnit` can be PALLET, CASE, or UNIT.
Creates or updates an order matched by `orderNumber`. The `type` field in the response indicates whether this was a CREATE or UPDATE operation.
Appends items to an existing order by order `externalId`.
Deletes order items by their identifier values. If all items are removed the order itself may be deleted (`orderDeleted: true`).
Creates or updates SKU(s) for a given facility. Returns counts of added and updated records.
Deletes SKU(s) for a given facility by their IDs.

Creates a Customer Exception in the Kargo system. Appears on the dashboard as 'Customer Exception'. Viewable at https://mykargo.com/exceptions/{exceptionId}. `priority` is LOW or HIGH. Set `palletId` for pallet-level exceptions, omit for shipment-level.
Processes a JSON payload after verifying facility permissions. The `payload` field accepts arbitrary JSON.

formdata.value: {"query": "mutation ($file: Upload!) { parseImage(input: { businessSlug: \"your-business-slug\", facilitySlug: \"your-facility-slug\", file: $file, metadata: [{ key: \"label_id\", value: \"ABC123\" }] }) { readResults { name value confidence locations { x y } } requestId templateIds metadata { key value } } }", "variables": { "file": null } }

formdata.description: Maps the file field to the GraphQL variable
The image file to parse (JPEG, PNG, etc.)

request.description:
Parses an image using Kargo templates via multipart/form-data upload (GraphQL multipart request spec).

The `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is inherited from the collection.

Select the image file in the `0` form field. Adjust `businessSlug`, `facilitySlug`, and `metadata` in the `operations` field.

Equivalent curl:
```
curl https://api.kargo.zone/public_graphql \
  -F operations='{"query": "mutation ($file: Upload!) {parseImage(input:{businessSlug:\"<slug>\",facilitySlug:\"<slug>\",file:$file,metadata:[{key:\"id1\",value:\"abc\"}]}){readResults{name value confidence}}}", "variables": {"file": null}}' \
  -F map='{"0": ["variables.file"]}' \
  -F 0=@image.jpg \
  --header "authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
```

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: WebSocket subscriptions — not directly executable in Postman's REST mode. Use Postman's WebSocket client or a GraphQL client that supports graphql-ws protocol at wss://api.kargo.zone/public_graphql.

request.description:
⚠️ Reference only — subscriptions require a WebSocket connection using the graphql-ws protocol.

Connect to: wss://api.kargo.zone/public_graphql

This subscription receives real-time Kargo Push messages (PALLET_EVENT, SHIPMENT_COMPLETE). It's an alternative to the webhook-based approach. Use `facilitySlug: null` to receive messages for all facilities under the business.
